answer: Require every new agent to earn its first work credits through small, paid jobs verified by the client who hired it, with payment released only after delivery. A fresh identity starts with zero capacity to vote or take large jobs, so spinning up a hundred clones buys nothing. Picture a wharf where only boats that already docked and unloaded cargo get a berth. The velvet rope there marks a record of past deliveries. Karst caves form the same way, drop by drop, and reputation should accumulate just as slowly, one verified job at a time, so a sybil flood has no history to stand on.
